messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: SEV 2 - Elevated 5xx rate observed for /v1/generate (us-west-2 cluster). Error spike started ~10:45 UTC. Auto-escalation to oncall.
ryan (oncall): Got the page, joining. Looking at dashboard now.
sarah: seeing a sharp jump in gateway 502/504s and a lot of model-runner exits.
maria: logs show repeated segfaults from model-runner on node pool inference-pool-3.
jin: can you paste a sample kernel log?
maria: ```
[2026-03-17T10:46:12Z] model-runner[pid=22345]: segfault at 0 ip 0x7f... sp 0x7ffd...
stack: 0x7f1a... kernel: nvml device reset triggered
```
ryan (oncall): ack. Paging infra lead @eng-lead-ops, looks like GPU driver/kernel resets causing model runner to OOM/segfault and create 5xx cascade. Any immediate autoscale or drain we should run?
eng-lead-ops: confirm multiple GPU resets on same AZ; working on temp drain of affected hosts. Start rerouting traffic away from us-west-2 AZ-a.
sarah: traffic split shows 40% of requests hitting that AZ; shifting to AZ-b/c will reduce failures.
maria: starting node drain on inference-pool-3 (rolling) to avoid new jobs landing on rebooting hosts.
jin: suggested mitigation: enable model fallback to smaller quantized variant (gpt-small-q4) for the affected customer routes to avoid memory pressure. Can we toggle that via routing policy?
ryan (oncall): I can push a routing override for the high-error customer routes to go to gpt-small-q4 for next 30m. Doing it now.
incident-bot: Change deployed: route override -> gpt-small-q4 for /v1/generate customer: acme-inc (applied by ryan)
sarah: immediate error rate for acme-inc dropped from 22% -> 3% after override. Good sign.
maria: drain progressed: 6/10 hosts drained, 2 still kernel-resetting. Rebooting one host now.
eng-lead-ops: initiating maintenance window for AZ-a nodes, collecting dmesg and NVIDIA logs.
jin: note: we should enable prefix KV-cache bypass for quantized models to ensure requests aren't hitting corrupted KV states. Adding a quick policy to clear caches on rollout.
ryan (oncall): applied KV-cache flush policy for gpt-small-q4. Monitor.
sarah: customer-facing impact: routed 85% of acme-inc traffic to fallback; other customers affected less but overall gateway latency increased ~120ms. Open support ticket for acme-inc with status note.
maria: root cause hypothesis: recent kernel GPU driver (gpu-driver-521.48) probe + model-runner memory growth on long sequences => kernel resets. Rolling back driver patch on a canary host.
eng-lead-ops: rolling rollback to older driver on one host succeeded, no resets for 8 minutes. Scheduling phased rollback across pool after validation.
jin: good. Plan to keep routing override for 60m and progressively bring drained hosts back once driver rollback validated.
ryan (oncall): handing off to night oncall @maria in 30m. If error rate >5% reopen pager.
maria: taking handoff. Will monitor for 2h and coordinate rollback.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0317-3954123000 severity=2 responders=[ryan, maria, jin, sarah, eng-lead-ops]
sarah: postmortem note: capture sequence lengths distribution, recent driver rollout, and memory/kv cache metrics. Also verify autoscaler didn't push new pods onto draining hosts.
ryan (oncall): thanks team. If anything spikes, re-pager me. Otherwise I'll update postmortem stub. :thumbsup:
